title: 1980's Cecil B Shaw and Harry Lanyon
description: The Shriners Caboose Unit raises funds for children's hospitals. Pictured here are Cecil Shaw on the left and Harry Lanyon standing on the step to the right. The Shriners' caboose was always a highlight, eagerly anticipated in every parade.
